`docs/research/xstate/79-r14-final-readiness-verdict.md` §7/§10; ADR-0016 Amendment 14.

title: Create the statechart persistence tables (machine_snapshots, machine_drain_journal, machine_events) and their Postgres repositories
body:
## Context
`docs/plan/24-internal-schemas.md` §17.6 defines the statechart persistence tables — `machine_snapshots` (with `lib_snapshot_ver`, `hmac_key_id`, `hmac_tag`, `chain_trips`), `machine_drain_journal` (CV-C65') and `machine_events` (append-only, written by `CvAuditPlugin`; `order_events` §8 specialises it) — and attributes their migration to "E29-T12", a ticket that does not exist. The persistence code already exists (`statechart/persistence.py`: `Persister` from E50-T10 and `Restorer` from E50-T49, both taking injected `SnapshotRepo` / `DrainJournal` / `PersistAudit` repositories), so the only missing piece is the relational schema and the SQLAlchemy repositories that implement those ports against Postgres. Filed by the orchestrator on 2026-10-19 as a plan gap found while sequencing E29-T03 (B1 recovers from `order_events` and does not create these tables).

## Scope / Deliverables
- One Alembic revision creating `machine_snapshots`, `machine_drain_journal` and `machine_events` exactly as 24 §17.6 specifies (columns, keys, indexes, append-only grants for `machine_events` per C-5.7), reversible `downgrade()`.
- `storage/repositories/` implementations of `SnapshotRepo`, `DrainJournal` and `PersistAudit` (asyncpg via SQLAlchemy 2.x async), wired through the factory's `build()` / `restore()` only (`statechart/factory.py` stays the single construction site).
- 24 §17.6: replace "migration E29-T12" with this ticket's key; 21-database-schema.md gains the three tables with their C-5.9 classification.

## Out of scope
Any machine-specific table (`order_events` is E29-T03's), the admin inspector screen (E42-S08), snapshot policy changes (ADR-0016 §persistence is final).

## Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Scenario: round-trip migration
  Given an empty database and a seeded database
  When alembic upgrade head, downgrade -1, upgrade head run
  Then both succeed and the three tables match 24 §17.6 column for column

Scenario: snapshot, drain and restore through the real repositories
  Given a built machine persisted at quiescence through Persister
  When the process restarts and Restorer.restore runs from the Postgres rows
  Then last_transition_ok is not None, the drain journal is replayed exactly once and the HMAC envelope verifies

Scenario: machine_events is append-only
  Given the application role
  When an UPDATE or DELETE is attempted on machine_events
  Then it is refused by the grant
```

## Technical notes / design
Follow 24 §17.6 verbatim (the schema doc is the contract); quarantine rows (`fault` set) never write a snapshot (MUST-01); `send_id` semantics from E50-T10. Migration slot: coordinate the head with the orchestrator (single-head check, C-5.3).

## Test plan
Unit: repository contract tests against the fakes already used by E50-T10/T49. Integration (`@pytest.mark.integration`): the three scenarios above on the compose Postgres; migrations round-trip in CI `migrations`.

## Security notes
HMAC envelope binds `machine_hash` (CV-C53); `hmac_key_id` references the secrets module's key id only — no key material in the table. `security-review` label (storage of audit-grade rows).

## Accessibility notes
n/a

## Performance notes
Snapshot writes are off the hot path by construction (C-2.20); index `machine_events (machine_kind, entity_id, ordinal)`.

## Observability
`cv_machine_snapshot_write_total`, `cv_machine_restore_total{outcome}` already registered by `CvMetricsPlugin`; the repositories add latency histograms per operation.

## Definition of Done
Migration merged and round-tripped in CI; repositories wired through the factory; 24 §17.6 and 21 updated; QA record on this issue.

## Dependencies
blocked_by E50-T10, E50-T49 (both Done).

## Branch
`feat/e50-t61-statechart-persistence-tables`

## References
24-internal-schemas.md §17.6; 29-statechart-adoption-plan.md (E50-T10, E50-T49 rows); ADR-0016; CONSTITUTION §5 (C-5.1–C-5.9), C-2.22 (CV-C53, CV-C65').

## Agent execution brief
- Read first: 24 §17.6, 29 §persistence rows, `statechart/persistence.py`, `21-database-schema.md` §audit tables, `.claude/rules/60-database-migrations.md`.
- Repo paths: `services/api/candleviewer/migrations/versions/`, `services/api/candleviewer/storage/repositories/`, `services/api/candleviewer/statechart/factory.py` (wiring only), `docs/plan/24-internal-schemas.md`, `docs/plan/21-database-schema.md`.
- Interfaces you must not break: `SnapshotRepo` / `DrainJournal` / `PersistAudit` ports; `cv.statechart.factory.build/restore` signatures.
- Commands: `AGENTS.md` §4 (backend lint/type/test; `alembic upgrade head && alembic downgrade -1 && alembic upgrade head`).
- Branch & PR: one PR ≤ 800 LOC, `Closes #<this issue>`, `security-review` label; migration slot agreed with the orchestrator before opening.
- Done means: the three Gherkin scenarios pass in CI; docs updated in the same PR.
- Do NOT: touch any machine JSON or `machine_hashes.lock`; create machine-specific tables; import `xstate_statemachine` outside `statechart/`.
- If blocked: comment on this issue with the BLOCKER template (`.claude/rules/70-multi-agent.md` §5).
